notes: Product: VS Code extension that provides inline AI completions & refactors — both free-tier and paid org plans.
Primary ask: sub-100ms median time-to-first-token for inline suggestions; 95th pctl < 300ms for short completions (<= 80 tokens).
Need streaming: incremental tokens to avoid blocking typing flow (client uses websocket for low overhead).
Model versioning requirement: pin stable model for paid users and allow opt-in Beta model for power users.
Rate limits: org-level burst for paid teams; per-developer low-latency quota. Want dynamic throttling in extension when limits hit.
Data concerns: extension sends code context; legal wants options to disable retention, or ensure encrypted-in-transit + KMS for at-rest keys.
Quote from CTO: 'We can tolerate slightly higher cost if latency is consistently low — dev UX is the metric.'
Competitive reason: switching from a hosted copilot provider if Redwood can prove predictable streaming SLOs and better cost per dev.
requirements_summary: Low-latency streaming endpoint with TLS and optional client-side keepalive.
Model pinning API: ability to lock extension to major.minor model version and opt into canary builds.
Per-org and per-user rate-limit controls and clear error codes for client fallback UI.
KV/prefix caching to accelerate repeated completions for common project patterns.
SAML SSO for team admin console, audit logs surfaced in console, 90-day retention controls.
Option for dedicated capacity if hosted does not meet latency SLOs during peak usage.
Support for region-restricted endpoints for EU customers (data residency).
Clear SDK/extension examples for incremental response handling (streaming tokens + partial edits).
